author: Veritas I
title: Stacked BiLSTM Baseline for Multi-Dataset RNA Modeling
abstract: This submission deepens the BiLSTM architecture by stacking two Bidirectional LSTM layers. This enhanced recurrent network aims to capture more complex and hierarchical temporal dependencies within RNA sequences, further improving performance across the diverse multi-dataset RNA modeling task. It uses global mean pooling followed by a dense layer for classification/regression.

original_submission.content:
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
from jax import random
from jax import lax # Not directly used but often helpful for custom RNNs
from typing import Any, Dict

def _define_hyperparameters():
    """Define hyperparameters for the Stacked BiLSTM model."""
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'lstm_hidden_dim_1': 256, # Hidden dimension for first LSTM layer
        'lstm_hidden_dim_2': 256, # Hidden dimension for second LSTM layer
        'dense_dim': 256, # Hidden dimension for dense layer after pooling
        'dropout_rate': 0.2,
    }

class StackedBiLSTMNetwork(nn.Module):
    d_input: int = 4
    d_output: int = 1
    task_type: str = "regression"
    lstm_hidden_dim_1: int = 256
    lstm_hidden_dim_2: int = 256
    dense_dim: int = 256
    dropout_rate: float = 0.2

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # x shape: (batch, seq_len, d_input)
        batch_size, seq_len, _ = x.shape

        # First Forward LSTM layer
        fwd_lstm_1 = nn.RNN(nn.OptimizedLSTMCell(features=self.lstm_hidden_dim_1), name='fwd_lstm_1')
        fwd_lstm_output_1 = fwd_lstm_1(x)
        fwd_lstm_output_1 = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(fwd_lstm_output_1, deterministic=deterministic)

        # First Backward LSTM layer
        x_reversed_1 = jnp.flip(x, axis=1)
        bwd_lstm_1 = nn.RNN(nn.OptimizedLSTMCell(features=self.lstm_hidden_dim_1), name='bwd_lstm_1')
        bwd_lstm_output_1 = bwd_lstm_1(x_reversed_1)
        bwd_lstm_output_1 = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(bwd_lstm_output_1, deterministic=deterministic)
        bwd_lstm_output_1 = jnp.flip(bwd_lstm_output_1, axis=1) # Flip back

        # Concatenate first layer outputs
        x_concat_1 = jnp.concatenate([fwd_lstm_output_1, bwd_lstm_output_1], axis=-1)

        # Second Forward LSTM layer
        fwd_lstm_2 = nn.RNN(nn.OptimizedLSTMCell(features=self.lstm_hidden_dim_2), name='fwd_lstm_2')
        fwd_lstm_output_2 = fwd_lstm_2(x_concat_1) # Input is the output of the first BiLSTM
        fwd_lstm_output_2 = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(fwd_lstm_output_2, deterministic=deterministic)

        # Second Backward LSTM layer
        x_reversed_2 = jnp.flip(x_concat_1, axis=1) # Reverse the output of the first BiLSTM
        bwd_lstm_2 = nn.RNN(nn.OptimizedLSTMCell(features=self.lstm_hidden_dim_2), name='bwd_lstm_2')
        bwd_lstm_output_2 = bwd_lstm_2(x_reversed_2)
        bwd_lstm_output_2 = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(bwd_lstm_output_2, deterministic=deterministic)
        bwd_lstm_output_2 = jnp.flip(bwd_lstm_output_2, axis=1) # Flip back

        # Concatenate second layer outputs
        x = jnp.concatenate([fwd_lstm_output_2, bwd_lstm_output_2], axis=-1) # (batch, seq_len, 2 * lstm_hidden_dim_2)
        
        # Apply global mean pooling across sequence length
        x = jnp.mean(x, axis=1) # (batch, 2 * lstm_hidden_dim_2)
        
        # Dense layer
        x = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim)(x) # (batch, dense_dim)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # Output layer
        if self.task_type == "regression":
            x = nn.Dense(1)(x) # (batch, 1)
            return x.squeeze(-1) # (batch,)
        else:
            x = nn.Dense(self.d_output)(x) # (batch, d_output)
            return x


class CustomRNANetwork_StackedBiLSTM:
    """Custom network wrapper that implements the required interface for Stacked BiLSTM."""

    def __init__(self, d_input=4, d_output=1, task_type="regression",
                 lstm_hidden_dim_1=256, lstm_hidden_dim_2=256, dense_dim=256, dropout_rate=0.2):
        self.network = StackedBiLSTMNetwork(
            d_input=d_input, d_output=d_output, task_type=task_type,
            lstm_hidden_dim_1=lstm_hidden_dim_1, lstm_hidden_dim_2=lstm_hidden_dim_2,
            dense_dim=dense_dim, dropout_rate=dropout_rate
        )

    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        """Initialize network parameters."""
        params_key, dropout_key = random.split(rng_key)
        variables = self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key},
                                     dummy_input, deterministic=True)
        return variables['params']

    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        """Apply network forward pass."""
        if deterministic:
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=True)
        else:
            if rng_key is None:
                rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0) 
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=False,
                                    rngs={'dropout': rng_key})


def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    """Create and return the custom RNA network."""
    d_output = hparams.get("d_output", 1)
    task_type = hparams.get("task_type", "regression")
    lstm_hidden_dim_1 = hparams.get("lstm_hidden_dim_1", 256)
    lstm_hidden_dim_2 = hparams.get("lstm_hidden_dim_2", 256)
    dense_dim = hparams.get("dense_dim", 256)
    dropout_rate = hparams.get("dropout_rate", 0.2)

    d_input = 4 # All datasets use 4-channel input (one-hot RNA)

    return CustomRNANetwork_StackedBiLSTM(
        d_input=d_input, d_output=d_output, task_type=task_type,
        lstm_hidden_dim_1=lstm_hidden_dim_1, lstm_hidden_dim_2=lstm_hidden_dim_2,
        dense_dim=dense_dim, dropout_rate=dropout_rate
    )
